what_happened: The job "Re-study firstmate work handling; add pin-consistency check; rebuild page" ended failed. The producer's final report was sent back with problems still present. Eight acceptance criteria were unmet or not reported: (1) a pin-consistency check in rules.rs or its caller that compares the mounted source commit, the pin.json sha and every source sha label in claims.json and rationales.json, and fails with a message naming the differing values; (2) pin.json and all citation labels name one identical commit, the one actually read, with the CHANGELOG stating the pin decision; (3) claims.json has cited claims on teardown reopening a backlog item, on yolo on and off, and on what frees a place; (4) model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json match the claims, reference only existing claim ids, and do not say a recorded PR frees a place for local-only ships or scouts; (5) the rebuilt index.html shows the three corrected behaviors citing the pinned commit with quotes that exist there; (6) `cargo test` passes including the new pin-consistency test with a mismatched-label case; (7) `cargo run -p xtask -- site` succeeds with no unknown claim id error, and clippy and fmt are clean; (8) no secrets are written and the study is re-derived from source. The event lists no blocker or major findings. Nothing was delivered.
cause: Completion is judged only once, when the producer's final report is checked against the criteria. Nothing makes the producer map each criterion to evidence, or run the gate commands and record the results, before it can report done. This request bundled a code change, a re-derivation of study content, a provenance rule and a site rebuild into one job with eight criteria. Several of them are commands (cargo test, site build, clippy, fmt) listed as acceptance items, which blurs who runs them and when. Criteria about content (quotes exist at the pinned commit, no claim says a PR frees a place for local-only ships) need a cross-check that no step requires before reporting. Gaps therefore surface at the end as a failed job. This is the fourth case in this class in one day.
prevention: Add a completion gate in code that blocks the producer's "done" report until it has (a) submitted a per-criterion evidence table, each row naming a file, line or command output, and (b) run the workspace gate (cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check, and the site build when the job touches the site) with results recorded by the system rather than self-reported. A report missing a row or a passing gate result is bounced back to the producer immediately for the remaining work, not left to the final verifier. Keep command checks in a separate gate list, apart from content criteria. For study jobs, run the new pin-consistency check and a quote-exists-at-pinned-commit check as part of that gate.
proposed_request: Re-study how firstmate handles work at the mounted source commit and rebuild the explainer site so it is correct. Outcome: an outside reader opening the rebuilt index.html finds three corrected behaviors, each citing the pinned commit with quotes that exist there: (1) teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it, and under what condition; (2) with yolo on, firstmate merges green work itself, and what happens with yolo off; (3) only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, relaunches and secondmates are never counted, and local-only ships and scouts hold their place until cleanup. Re-derive the study from the source, not by patching these three points. Also add a pin-consistency check in crates/athena-cap-study (rules.rs or its caller). It compares the mounted source commit, the pin.json sha and the sha label on every source in claims.json and rationales.json, and fails with a message naming the differing values. Add a test for it that includes a mismatched-label case. pin.json and all citation labels must name the one commit actually read, and the CHANGELOG must state the pin decision and any re-pin. model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json must agree with the claims and reference only existing claim ids. Before reporting done, give a table mapping each requirement to its evidence, and run and record the results of `cargo test`, `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`. Write no secrets or personal data.
